'''Amenomurakumo no Mikoto''' (天村雲命, birth and death years unknown) was an ancient figure in Japan and a distant ancestor of the {{ill|Owari clan|en|Owari clan|qid=Q11465311|lt=Owari clan}}.
== Overview ==
Amenomurakumo no Mikoto was the child of {{ill|Takakuraji|ja|高倉下命}}, active during the reign of {{ill|Emperor Jimmu|en|Emperor Jimmu|qid=Q200188|lt=Emperor Jimmu}}, and is considered the ancestor of the {{ill|Owari clan|ja|尾張連}} and {{ill|Tsumori clan|ja|津守連}}. In records like the ''{{ill|Kujiki|lt=Tenson Honki|ja|天孫本紀|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kujiki|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to QID FIXED|qid=Q2716751}}'', he is commonly referred to as Amenomurakumo no Mikoto.
He is also known by the name ''Amainotate'' (天五多底).
== Shrines Enshrining Amenomurakumo no Mikoto ==
* {{ill|Yahiko Shrine|en|Yahiko Shrine|qid=Q195684|lt=Yahiko Shrine}} (Niigata Prefecture, Nishikanbara District, Yahiko Village)
* {{ill|Ibuki Shrine|ja|伊富岐神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ibuki Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11379321}} (Gifu Prefecture, Fuwa District, Tarui Town)
* {{ill|Mizushi Shrine|ja|水主神社 (城陽市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizuushi Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q54153262}} (Kyoto Prefecture, Jōyō City)
* Arami Shrine (Kyoto Prefecture, Jōyō City)
* {{ill|Tamura Shrine|en|Tamura Shrine|qid=Q11576978|lt=Tamura Shrine}} (Kagawa Prefecture, Takamatsu City)
